title: TrustMix: Graceful Degradation for Pretrained Models under Distribution Shift
abstract: arXiv:2611.07206v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Predicting beyond the training domain necessarily requires assumptions about how the ground truth extrapolates, yet in most neural networks these assumptions are made only implicit through the architecture. We propose TrustMix, a lightweight post-hoc method that makes a pretrained model's extrapolative behaviour explicit and controllable. TrustMix combines the predictive distribution produced by a pretrained model with a user-specified fallback distribution $p_0(y|x)$, such that as the out-of-distribution (OOD) deviation statistic grows, we collapse towards $p_0(y|x)$. TrustMix provides graceful degradation: the predictive distribution converges toward the fallback distribution as the OOD signal grows. The fallback distribution $p_0(y|x)$ can reflect domain knowledge, if available, or rely on a domain-agnostic stationarity assumption. translated_title: TrustMix：分布偏移下预训练模型的优雅降级
translated_abstract: 在训练域之外进行预测必然需要对真实值如何外推做出假设，然而在大多数神经网络中，这些假设仅通过架构隐式地体现。我们提出TrustMix，这是一种轻量级的后处理（post-hoc）方法，能够使预训练模型的外推行为变得明确且可控。TrustMix将预训练模型产生的预测分布与用户指定的回退分布 p₀(y|x) 相结合，随着分布外（OOD）偏离统计量的增大，预测分布逐渐向 p₀(y|x) 坍缩。TrustMix提供了优雅降级：随着OOD信号的增强，预测分布收敛到回退分布。回退分布 p₀(y|x) 可以反映可用的领域知识，或者依赖于与领域无关的平稳性假设。TrustMix无需对基础模型进行重新训练，并且可以同时应用于回归和分类任务。
tldr: TrustMix是一种无需重训练的轻量级后处理方法，它根据OOD偏离程度将预训练模型的预测分布与用户指定的回退分布混合，使模型外推行为显式可控并实现优雅降级。
en_tdlr: TrustMix is a lightweight, retraining-free post-hoc method that mixes a pretrained model's predictive distribution with a user-specified fallback distribution based on OOD deviation, making extrapolation explicit, controllable, and gracefully degrading.
